Mistress '''Heilin''' is the [[innkeeper]] of [[The White Ring]], an inn in [[Maderin]], [[Altara]].

==Appearance==
Mistress Heilin is a round woman with a full bosom and black hair.{{ref/book|11|11}}

==Activities==
Mistress Heilin greets [[Matrim Cauthon]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]], [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], and [[Selucia]] when they enter her inn. She has [[Jera]] serve them her best wine.{{ref/book|11|11}}
